title: Abhyankar maximal-ideal equality for a local DVR compositum diagram
statement: Let B,A,U,T be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with a finite faithful B-algebra A [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], a local B-algebra U, and a local A-algebra T. Let n>0 and e be natural numbers with e a unit in B and e dividing n. Suppose m_B A=m_A^n and m_B U=m_U^e. Write k(V)=V/m_V for the residue field of a local ring V, and assume k(U)/k(B) is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let E be a finite separable extension of Frac(B) [def-pc-field-extension] with compatible B-algebra structure. Give E a U-algebra structure making E the fraction field of U, compatibly with B. Let F be a field, an A-algebra, and i:E->F a ring homomorphism such that i(b)=b for b in B, through the specified maps. Assume F is generated as an A-algebra by i(E). Give F a T-algebra structure making F the fraction field of T, compatibly with A. Suppose j:U->T is local, agrees on B with B->A->T, and its composite U->T->F equals U->E->F. Then the extension of the maximal ideal of A to T is the maximal ideal of T: m_A T = m_T. This is the weakly unramified conclusion for A -> T.

theorem dvr_abhyankar_local_map_maximalIdeal
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Algebra B A] [Module.Finite B A] [FaithfulSMul B A]
    (hindex : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n)
    (U : Type u) [CommRing U] [IsDomain U] [IsDiscreteValuationRing U]
    [Algebra B U] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B U)]
    (e : ℕ) (he : IsUnit (e : B)) (hedvd : e ∣ n)
    (hindexU : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B U) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal U ^ e)
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField U))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    [Algebra B E] [IsScalarTower B (FractionRing B) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E] [Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E]
    [Algebra U E] [IsFractionRing U E] [IsScalarTower B U E]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra A F] (iE : E →+* F)
    (hcomm : ∀ b : B, iE (algebraMap B E b) =
      algebraMap A F (algebraMap B A b))
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin A (Set.range iE) = ⊤)
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [IsDiscreteValuationRing T]
    [Algebra A T] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A T)]
    [Algebra T F] [IsFractionRing T F] [IsScalarTower A T F]
    (j : U →+* T) (hj : IsLocalHom j)
    (hjB : ∀ b : B, j (algebraMap B U b) =
      algebraMap A T (algebraMap B A b))
    (hjE : ∀ c : U, algebraMap T F (j c) = iE (algebraMap U E c)) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A T) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T
